docs.summary: Immediate-mode transform handles for scene tools. Wraps Origami's [`TransformGizmo`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Gizmo.TransformGizmo) so an editor can manipulate an arbitrary world point/transform (not just a GameObject): e.g. a light probe, a spline knot, a bounds corner. Each handle owns a [`ControlID`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.SceneView.ControlID), so it arbitrates against every other handle in the viewport instead of unilaterally consuming input. Call a handle method from `OnSceneInput` each frame (it applies the drag to the `ref` values), then call [`Draw`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.SceneView.TransformHandles~Draw) from `DrawOverlay` to render the handles touched this frame. Each distinct `id` keeps its own drag state across frames.
